reviewSamples.author: Jeffrey Diaz
reviewSamples.text: Julio and his son are absolutely the best !! Best service every single time I come by . I bring mine, my wife's and mother in law's car i don't go no where else but here .. they're like family and i will always reccomend them . God bless this business

reviewSamples.author: Jose G Borda
reviewSamples.text: I recommend Julio's auto repairs, a trustworthy and friendly place. Great price and great servuce

reviewSamples.author: J O
reviewSamples.text: $60 for a used tire. In and out within 20 minutes and they had 4 other clients they were attending to. Third time going here, they don't disappoint. Thank you guys. I can always count you for a quick service. I don't know what happened to my tire, but I consider myself lucky it didn't blow up.

reviewSamples.author: Moises Arguez
reviewSamples.text: Purchased 4 new tires for my vehicle and the service I received was great, Julio Jr. and his crew provided excellent and efficient service. They worked together to get me in and out quickly.

reviewSamples.author: Jorge Pichardo
reviewSamples.text: Great service and even better price!
